tickets.title: Ceiling Projector HDMI Flickering & Purple Tint in Room 302
tickets.description: During Operating Systems lecture, the main EPSON projector kept resetting and flickering with severe magenta color distortion. Slides are impossible to read from middle & back rows.
tickets.advisorNote: Verified during 3rd hour lecture. Approved with +20 Strong Weightage and escalated to Main Admin.
tickets.adminNote: Technician Vignesh dispatched with 15m optical HDMI cable and replacement splitter.

comments.text: True! Happened yesterday too. The HDMI wall panel socket is loose.
✅ Official Class Advisor Approval (+20 Weightage): Verified the issue during 3rd hour. Escalated with High Priority to Main Admin & Estate AV unit.

tickets.title: Ceiling Fan Regulator Stuck at Speed 1 — Humming Noise in Rm 304
tickets.description: The ceiling fan in Agastya Bhavan Room 304 cannot be turned to higher speeds. Regulator knob spins loose and motor makes a loud buzzing vibration.
tickets.wardenNote: Approved by Resident Warden Agastya Bhavan (+20 Weightage). Forwarded to Main Admin for electrical dispatch.
tickets.adminNote: Replaced fan step-regulator module and lubricated bearing. Marked as fixed. Please test and confirm on app!

comments.text: ✅ Official Hostel Resident Warden Approval (+20 Weightage): Inspected Room 304 and approved for immediate electrical maintenance.
Electrician checked the unit at 2:00 PM. Kindly approve if functioning properly.

tickets.title: ⚠️ High-Voltage Exposed Wire Hanging Near Pathway Puddle
tickets.description: Behind RadhaKrishna CIR Hall leading to Academic Block 2, a severed conduit is resting in water puddle after noon rain. High electric hazard for pedestrians.
tickets.location: Walkway between RadhaKrishna Hall (CIR) and Academic Block 2
tickets.adminNote: Emergency barricading placed. Power breaker 4 isolated. Cable being re-routed underground.

tickets.title: Broken Dual-Desk Benches & Loose Power Strip in CSE-B Classroom
tickets.description: Three wooden benches in the 4th row of CSE-B 3rd Year classroom have loose backrest bolts and the laptop charging socket strip is sparking intermittently.

tickets.title: RO Drinking Water Cooler Dispensing Warm Unfiltered Water on 3rd Floor
tickets.description: The main drinking water dispenser in Agastya Bhavan 3rd Floor corridor has a clogged filter indicator blinking red and cooling compressor is off since morning.
tickets.location: Agastya Bhavan - 3rd Floor North Wing Corridor

tickets.title: [Advisor Direct Complaint] Upgrade Faulty LAN Switches & Smart Board Audio in CSE-B
tickets.description: Filed directly by Class Advisor (CSE-B 3rd Year): Multiple students unable to connect to local lab subnet during compiler sessions and smart board speaker amplifier is dead.
tickets.advisorNote: Directly raised by Class Advisor CSE-B for immediate Main Admin action.

tickets.title: [Warden Direct Complaint] Solar Water Heater Manifold Valve Leak in Agastya Bhavan
tickets.description: Filed directly by Hostel Resident Warden (Agastya Bhavan): Hot water pressure valve on terrace Wing-A is leaking continuously, affecting morning supply for 120 residents.
tickets.location: Agastya Bhavan - Terrace Wing-A Solar Plant
tickets.wardenNote: Directly raised by Resident Warden Agastya Bhavan to Main Admin.
tickets.adminNote: Heavy-duty brass manifold valve ordered; plumbing crew on terrace.

tickets.title: Air Conditioner Stabilizer Tripping Repeatedly in CSE-A Lecture Hall
tickets.description: Split AC unit #2 in CSE-A 3rd Year classroom trips every 15 minutes with error code E4. Room gets extremely humid during afternoon lab.
tickets.advisorNote: Approved by Class Advisor CSE-A (Dr. M. Senthil Nathan). Forwarded to Main Admin.
